rule_order: Longest known prefix first; literal UTF-8 replacement only; no execution or program reconstruction

tokens.@USER_CARGO@: Historical user Cargo location if present
tokens.@USER_RUSTUP@: Historical user rustup location if present

status_hash_semantics: stdout_sha256/stderr_sha256 and MIR hashes in captured statuses/results refer to raw observations. Match raw_sha256 here; package manifest binds normalized published bytes.
